searchIndex.text: Chapter 10 The SIMA Methodology The IoT Mindset “If you think that the Internet has changed your life, think again. The Internet of Things is about to change it all over again.” -Brendan O’Brien, CEO of Number0 One of the key methods for the SIMA Journey to achieve its goals is to harness IoT. Not just IoT devices, gadgets and appliances. Not just IoT technology. The IoT mindset. The IoT mindset is the soul of the IoT revolution. Why do we need an IoT mindset as opposed to just needing IoT technology? Why does innovative thinking always have to come before technical application? When we think about IoT, many people think of home automation. Smart switches and IoT-infused appliances. Some more technically savvy folks may think of grid modernization. Equipment like the DRC series of VP.Start that use IoT sensors to collect data from the electric grid. Others may think of IoT sensors deployed in smart city operations. IoT sensors to monitor weather conditions, traffic patterns, waste generation and collection patterns. A few may think of smart medicine, smart agriculture, smart fisheries, smart mining and so on. IoT sensors and smart switches to improve the efficiency of medical 357 equipment, IoT sensor to monitor soil moisture levels for smart irrigation and crop rotation, IoT sensors to monitor water conditions and fish growth levels in aquaculture and fish farming, IoT sensors to monitor air quality and other safety concerns in mining operations. These are all aspects of IoT technology and there are many more across all economic sectors. And yet, this is only scratching the surface of the IoT mindset. At its core, the IoT mindset is the inescapable, indispensable key pillar of the sustainability system. There is no SIMA Journey of VP.Start without the IoT mindset. IoT by definition is about “things”. Equipment, machinery, ranging from small home appliances and personal devices to massive machinery in smart manufacturing and robotics-based engineering. IoT is the method that determines how machines interface with people, people interface with machines and most powerfully, how machines interface with other machines, automatically and eventually autonomously. Are you ready to leverage the power of the IoT revolution? Are you willing to interface with machines for a more sustainable future? At the basic level, it might be something as simple 358

searchIndex.title: Chapter 10 The SIMA Methodology The IoT Mindset “If you think that the Internet has changed your life, think again
searchIndex.text: as you monitoring your air conditioner’s electric usage on the AlienCheck app or as simple as your electric water pot informing you that it is losing efficiency and approaching the end of its lifespan. At a more sophisticated level, it might be equipment in a factory coordinating to maximize efficiency and minimize power usage and cost and to avoid overloading the power system to keep manufacturing moving forward robotically 24 hours a day. At the highly advanced level, it could be IoT sensors monitoring weather conditions in conjunction with AI weather models to make predictive maintenance of vulnerable aging infrastructure and to prepare for weather-related developments in power usage, including adjusting levels of renewable energy integration in real-time at millisecond intervals. The SIMA Journey is working in all of these levels , creating smart switches and smart metering for home appliances and office equipment, developing IoT sensors for a wide variety of heterogeneous smart city monitoring systems and producing IoT-based Grid Enhancing Technologies (GETs) to upgrade the efficiency of the power grid, such as IoT sensor-based smart rerouting of electric current around bottlenecks (Transmission Topology Optimization) and IoT-sensors that monitor real-time weather conditions to constantly and instantly update a power lines true carrying 359 capacity (Dynamic Line Rating) As powerful as all of these emerging and developing IoT capabilities are, they are still not as powerful as the IoT mindset. This is the mindset underpinning IoT technology, a mindset that promotes the collaboration of humankind and machinekind. We are no longer enemies struggling and competing for precious resources like fuel and money and rare earth minerals. Man and machine are partners working together to make the world more sustainable. This is the powerful IoT mindset that empowers the SIMA Journey. Reframing and redefining electrical equipment and appliances as our friends, this is the revolutionary aspect of the IoT mindset. Just as we “friend” the people that we want to communicate with on social media, It is time for us to “friend” our gadgets and devices , our cities and factories, our power grid. The IoT mindset provides the framework that makes this possible. Are you prepped and primed to adopt the IoT mindset? You will never succeed in IoT adoption until you succeed in IoT mindset adoption VP.Start has been aggressively and unflinchingly pushing forward the IoT mindset. We have already, as of this writing, integrated more than 10,000 IoT-infused DRC devices into the electric grid across all the provinces of Cambodia. Not bad for a start, but we want to integrate more that 1,000,000 IoT devices to bring 360

searchIndex.title: Chapter 10 The SIMA Methodology The IoT Mindset “If you think that the Internet has changed your life, think again
searchIndex.text: the conventional Cambodian grid up to the SIMA Smart Grid-level. Simultaneously, we are just starting a pilot project backed by NGO grants to bring this same IoT power to the electric grid in Laos. These are just the opening salvos in our SIMA IoT Revolution as we spread the power of IoT across ASEAN, across South Asia and across the developing world. According to research by the McKinsey Global Institute, there has been a major shift in IoT adoption with a major acceleration in China and also across the emerging world. China, for example, is shifting from a major IoT manufacturing hub to increasingly a major IoT purchasing market. The research suggests that by 2030, China will account for 26% of the global IoT market and emerging markets of the developing world will account for 19%, both major increases over 2020. Furthermore, B2C sales are expected to grow exponentially and outstrip B2B sales of IoT which is currently the largest area. The time is right for a company like VP.Start that has IoT devices and solutions that are uniquely suitable to the developing world because their cost-effectiveness makes them budget-friendly to countries dealing with substantial budgetary constraints. When the time is right, are you prepared to be in the vanguard of change? Or would you rather play it safe and let others take the lead? Unfortunately, there are 4 major factors that are hampering and hindering IoT adoption. 361 The first, of course, is price. Potential consumers, both individual and corporate, are concerned about the initial costs of IoT and have doubts about the long-term ROI of IoT integration. Such fears are certainly not warranted with the IoT revolution of VP.Start. The EDC, Cambodia’s utility, has already had a long-standing relationship with VP.Start, using the DRC and other IoT solutions for more than 12 years. It goes without saying, but I will say it anyway, Utilities don’t like to waste money or pay massive start-up costs for limited return on investment. As already stated repeatedly, the IoT solutions of the SIMA Journey are plug-and-play (low installation costs), intuitive (low training and maintenance costs), leverage the existing infrastructure (low operation costs) and VP.Start is also willing to make unique financing arrangements such as pay-as-you-go as needed. ROI begins from the moment of installation as the grid or the factory or the home devices become more efficient so that the initial cost is quickly covered and the savings continue to add up. Are you willing to pay initial costs for greater ROI down the road? Do you have the patience and fortitude to accept slightly delayed gratification? The second concern is complexity . Especially for B2C IoT purchasers for home automation and small-scale IoT usage, many potential buyers are reluctant to adopt IoT solutions because they feel that IoT devices may be too technical and too complicated to use. To be completely candid, many factory owners and large business leaders share a similar fear of IoT complexity. 362

searchIndex.title: Chapter 10 The SIMA Methodology The IoT Mindset “If you think that the Internet has changed your life, think again
searchIndex.text: This also is an unwarranted concern. The IoT devices of VP.Start are intuitive and easy to use. No advanced technical expertise is required. For example, in the case of IoT devices in the grid, the RPM Grid lays out the details of the IoT monitoring system in clear, easy to understand visualization. The UCN app takes visualization and intuitiveness to the next level, meaning simple understanding of the grid data is available on a mobile device. In the case of home and office automation, the IoT devices, smart switches and the like, interface with the highly user-friendly AlienCheck app, makes IoT usage very simple and efficient, indeed. Are you able to overcome your fear of complexity to join the IoT revolution? The third concern is interoperability. This is, to some extent, a valid concern. IoT devices, sensors, smart switches, smart meters and so on, are produced, as you might expect, by a wide variety of IoT providers. Different specifications. Different parameters. Different compliance frameworks. If each device from each company requires its own app to monitor, this will quickly become an exceedingly troublesome and inefficient situation. Furthermore, buying all IoT devices from the same company is neither cost-effective nor wise, either. As a result, many potential IoT customers ultimately decide against IoT adoption. Fortunately, VP.Start has already recognized this dilemma and solved the problem of IoT fragmentation and the lack of IoT interoperability in advance. The UCN, AlienCheck, is an app designed to accommodate a wide variety 363 of IoT from various providers in one unified platform. After all, it can hardly be called “universal” or part of the overarching sustainability system unless it is open to the full spectrum of IoT. AlienCheck does not favor or encourage the use of IoT produced and provided by VP.Start or by any other provider. It is completely provider-agnostic as an effective Universal Connectivity Network MUST be. Are you willing to be customer-centric instead of sales-centric? Can you put the needs of consumers and users above the desire to sell your products exclusively? Customers are looking for companies that value them more than they value their bottom lines. The final and largest concern is cybersecurity. This challenge is so large and significant that it merits its own chapter in the SIMA Methodology. The IoT Revolution has already started. It will not stop. What role do you want to play? Make your decision quickly. Time waits for no one! 364

searchIndex.text: 365 363 Chapter 11 SIMA Methodology Cybersecurity in an Insecure World “The very best cybersecurity is to have innovative ideas. They cannot be stolen or hacked.” -CEO Phally We live at an insecure time on an insecure planet. Insecure geopolitically . Insecure economically . Insecure ethically . Insecure environmentally . How can we hope to achieve cybersecurity, or any kind of security, in the current circumstance? Do your innovative solutions help people to cope with life in an insecure world? One of the most important methodologies of the SIMA Journey is cybersecurity . It is the methodology that investors and customers and potential partners ask about the most. By far. And yet, we live in an age when malicious actors are getting smarter, hacking tools and approaches are getting more sophisticated and the reasons for cyber attacks are becoming more diversified . Are your solutions and creative ideas well-equipped to face the growing cyberchallenge? 366

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Methodology Cybersecurity in an Insecure World “The very best cybersecurity is to have innovative ideas
searchIndex.text: A good framework for cyber security impacts everything that VP.Start does, especially: 1) SIMA Smart Grid Modernization 2) IoT Connectivity in the SIMA City and SIMA Home Initiatives, 3) SIMA Big Data and Cloud Computing and 4) AI capabilties such as those in the AlienCheck UCN app In other words, EVERYTHING. Let’s be clear on this. This is not a book on cybersecurity technology. This is a book on cybersecurity methodology . And ultimately, this is a book on the mindset that makes cybersecurity work or fail. Do you have the cybersecurity mindset that is required by all innovators? Let’s start with the SIMA Smart Grid because this is the foundational mission. The SIMA Smart Grid is powerful because it integrates smart meters, IoT monitoring devices like the DRC series for data acquisition, SCADA systems like the RPM Grid for data visualization, the PLUM app for remote data management and many other digital components. These digital attributes make the grid efficient, reliable and affordable BUT they also make it digitally attackable. Increasingly, militaries in various countries are studying cyber warfare strategies to disable smart grids. Such an attack could put a nation’s entire grid infrastructure at risk. Based on this threat, the SIMA Smart Grid practices strict segmentation 367 which means that a successful attack on one component can be contained and isolated. Furthermore, all remote and vendor access is subjected to multiple authentication steps . Additionally, VP.Start carries out regular “red-team exercises” to simulate cyber attacks and counter them effectively. But let’s be clear and completely honest. There is no 100% foolproof methodology to prevent all possible attacks. You might feel fearful to hear that. You might even think that attacks are basically inevitable at some point. Perhaps you are right. But let me ask you something. Do you use internet banking with a banking app? I suspect most of us do. Are you convinced that banking apps are invulnerable to attack? They are not. They can be attacked just like any other digital platform. Our money is at risk. And yet, we continue to use these apps . And unless, we are extremely tech savvy individuals, we probably are unaware of the cybersecurity protocols that the banks use. We use the apps because they are convenient and helpful. AND we trust the banks. The same is true for online shopping, internet browsing, email usage, social media posting and any other online activity. 368

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Methodology Cybersecurity in an Insecure World “The very best cybersecurity is to have innovative ideas
searchIndex.text: There is risk and the risk is real. Still, we continue to use these apps because we appreciate the convenience and trust the provider. The SIMA Smart Grid is a similar situation. Even if you were told all of the latest cybersecurity advancements of VP.Start, no disrespect intended, would you really understand them? I certainly would not. Only a dedicated cyber security specialist would be able to understand such a complex topic. BUT…is the SIMA Smart Grid convenient? Absolutely, in so many ways. Do you trust the provider? Do you trust VP.Start? That is the ultimate cybersecurity question. Are you building trust in your ideas, your plans and your organization? Are you forging trust so strong that it can last even when the customer doesn’t really understand? IoT connectivity follows a similar pattern to the SIMA Smart Grid in terms of cybersecurity. The SIMA City initiatives places IoT devices all over the city . The SIMA Home initiatives places IoT devices in homes, offices, factories, businesses and shops. The SIMA Universe, the AlienCheck app unites those IoT devices and their data in one powerful connectivity network. Outstandingly efficient and helpful. But each IoT sensor is a potential target, creating a wider target surface , many potential points for nefarious actors to launch their attacks. For example, sophisticated hackers and cyber criminals can create 369 “shadow” IoT devices to infiltrate the UCN. They can alter or compromise existing IoT devices to make them malignant and to infect the system. Once again, the keys are restricted access and network segmentation . The number of people able to access the system is kept to the absolute bare minimum and authorization protocols are intensif ied maximally . IoT devices, while connected by the UCN, are simultaneously isolated and segmented so that any attack on one IoT device or sensor does not spread throughout the entire network. And yet, I must return to the point at the soul of cybersecurity . Authorization, restricted access, encryption and firewalls are powerful but not omnipotent. It is not easy, needless to day, but they can be breached and overcome. The two questions: Are the benefits of urban automation and home automation considerable? No doubt. Do you trust the SIMA Journey? This is the one essential question. Do people trust your journey? If no, why not? If yes, how can you build that trust even further? SIMA Big Data is the part of the SIMA Journey where all the data that VP.Start has gathered from the grid, IoT devices and the UCN is used for simulations to turn that data into actionable intelligence. Data acquisition leads to data simulations. Data simulations inform data-based decisions. 370

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Methodology Cybersecurity in an Insecure World “The very best cybersecurity is to have innovative ideas
searchIndex.text: The results of those decisions generate more data. In an endless cycle. Yet this valuable data can be tampered with at any stage in the process. There can insider access to data repositories. There can intentional data manipulations, additions or eliminations. There can be cyber attacks at the point of acquisition, storage, retrieval, simulation or application. One altered piece of data can set off a chain reaction through various data sets, digital twins, simulations and can even damage projects and large scale plans . Of course, these threats can be mitigated with strict data governance , encryption across all data transit points, frequent cloud reconfiguration and regular vulnerability screening . Mitigated but not completely eliminated. As we have already seen repeatedly, these strategies can greatly lower the risk but cannot absolutely prevent a cyber breach. Since cyber challenges cannot be prevented absolutely, should we let our customers know that? In some ways, AI presents the biggest challenge in terms of cybersecurity. And yet, it is absolutely essential to a powerful Smart Grid and to a meaningful Universal Connectivity Network. 371 AI cyber security attacks can come in many forms. Malicious actors can introduce “data poisoning” to sabotage real results, can craft malicious examples and prompts that overcome AI defenses and worst of all, can attempt to alter the underlying prompt guardrails to change the core LLM instructions. AI capabilities can even be used to find ways to overcome AI protocols. Who could even begin to dare to try to counter AI-infused cyber attacks? It requires constant monitoring with humans in the loop and even then it is unlikely to be sufficient in all cases. Yes, there is the 4-part FEAR Framework (Firewalls, Encryption, Algorithmic Passwords and Restricted Access). Yes, there is CIA (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability) , the triad that supports cybersecurity doctrine. Yes, there are countless new strategies for cybersecurity and they are growing exponentially. Yes, VP.Start outsources cybersecurity to the industry leaders for cutting edge solutions as well as developing in-home solutions for both prevention and recovery. But if you gained anything from this chapter, it should be the fact that cybersecurity is never sufficient , not perfectly, at least. So, do you trust VP.Start and the SIMA Journey? Let me give you my perspective. 372

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Methodology Cybersecurity in an Insecure World “The very best cybersecurity is to have innovative ideas
searchIndex.text: I don’t care for salespeople. They try to convince me to buy things I don’t want, I don’t need and I can’t afford. In other words, they don’t care about me . They only care about selling a product and making a profit. VP.Start is never like that. They recommend solutions and find out if they suit my needs. If these solutions are helpful and profitable for me, they are happy to have me as a customer . On the other hand, if they are not particularly useful for me, outside of my budget or not interesting to me, VP.Start will never use pressure to try to sell them to me. Even if they are very useful and cost-effective for me, if I don’t see that, if I don’t FBR (feel, believe and remember) the solutions, VP.Start will never give me sales pressure . What does that have to do with cybersecurity? EVERYTHING. I trust in VP.Start because they care about me and they respect their own ideas, as well. I can trust them in the things that I understand and so in the areas that I don’t, as well. I know that they will do the best to protect their data and cyber systems because they care about me and they care about their outcomes and they care about a sustainable future. As Phally said in the opening quote, 373 the best way to have cybersecurity and indeed, any kind of security, is to have very innovative ideas. Data can be hacked. Information can be stolen. No one can steal innovative ideas. A few years back, several ex-team members left VP.Start to start their own company. When they left, they stole a lot of coding, product specifications and detailed, confidential internal information. VP.Start did not sue them or take them to court or try to stop them. Why? Because VP.Start knew well that creative, innovative ideas can NEVER be stolen. They belong to the innovator and no one else can harness them. EVER. That is what cybersecurity really means. Do you believe in your ideas enough to protect them? Is your protection plan adequate? Do you have a backup plan if the first plan fails? Do you care enough about your customers to protect their data as if it were your own? Do you have the kind of innovative, creative ideas that are impossible for others to steal? 374

searchIndex.text: Chapter 12 SIMA Methodology The Time is Now for Mindfulness “The present moment is f illed with joy and happiness. If you are attentive, you will see it.” -Thich Nhat Hahn, Vietnamese Buddhist teacher and author When you think of business methodology, what do you think of ? Probably, business plans and marketing strategies, joint ventures, partnerships and collaborations, customer research and product development, investment and pitching, testing and quality control, and any number of other strategic plans come to mind. Of course, VP.Start employs all of those techniques as part of the SIMA Journey. Furthermore, team building is another important aspect of many companies’ business models. Companies increasingly recognize the power of staff buy-in and decentralized brand ambassadorship . VP.Start values these areas of focus as well but being VP.Start, they take these concepts to a revolutionary, radical place. What strategies do you consider mission critical to growing your business and building your ideas? 375 In your honest opinion, are these strategies succeeding as you would hope? The SIMA Journey doesn’t require mere teamwork and buy-in. It requires mindfulness on behalf of all the team members, all the time. Radical mindfulness. Unequivocal mindfulness. Is such a lofty goal even attainable? Are you as mindful as you want to be? Do you feel like you have sufficient, adequate powers of concentration? Are you pleased with your overall productivity and growth, personally and professionally? VP.Start in conjunction with Vipassa International has started meditation and mindfulness training for ALL employees. Not just the management. Not just the upper levels. Everyone in the workforce. Every three months, using one full work day of the ENTIRE team for this training. Now, let me be quick to say that this is not a religious training . While Buddhism is very popular in Cambodia, not all VP.Start team members are Buddhist. This training is not in religious meditation. It is about developing concentration. Deepening focus. Increasing productivity by moving into the present fully. Do you think that you could benefit from being more fully in the present? 376

searchIndex.title: Chapter 12 SIMA Methodology The Time is Now for Mindfulness “The present moment is f illed with joy and happiness
searchIndex.text: Mr.Chhunny of Vipassa, a famous author on mindfulness in Cambodia, himself, stated that the goal of this training is to get at the human system behind innovation. At VP.Start, the emphasis is on innovation through technology, as you kno by this point. Innovation MUST come before technology. According to mindfulness theory, a strong inner foundation MUST come before innovation. The goal is not creative thinking. This is just the result. The goal is creative being, which is living in the moment. The very first training session focused on “Building the Inner Foundation.” This is achieved through: deep listening, achieving a balance of EQ and IQ and developing powerful, positive habits. While these lessons, of course, apply to everyone and every situation, they are especially salient for a progressive and idea-driven company like VP.Start. They are the methodology that takes VP.Start to the global stage and allows VP.Start to dare of dreaming to change the world. Do you feel like you have a solid inner foundation? Or do you feel like you need to strengthen your inner being to become more innovative? In the business context, what is deep listening ? It means to listen to every idea, opinion and business proposal without judgment . 377 This is not as easy as it sounds. Every team members has ideas that should be respected, understood and, at times, implemented. Even if they are not implemented, the team member needs to feel that her or his idea is valued and time has been taken to understand the ideas correctly. A deep listener is not concerned about preparing a good response to what they are hearing. Unfortunately, often in business and even sometimes at VP.Start, the leadership team can be more concerned about crafting an impressive response than truly understanding the initial idea. This is human nature. A deep listener summarizes the opinion or proposal back to the originator, to make sure they have understood accurately. At this point, the originator either accepts the summary of the deep listener or makes modifications if the deep listener has not perfectly grasped the concept. In this deep listening approach to communication, wanting to understand is just as important as actually understanding. This forges a deep bond of trust among all team members and allows everyone to share ideas freely. In such a workplace atmosphere, just as importantly, even if an idea is ultimately rejected, bitterness will not develop. Are you a deep listener? What benefits would accrue to you from learning to listen more deeply? Another issue in building a powerful team that can be truly mindful is making sure that every team member has IQ and EQ in balance. In a simple way of thinking about it, 378

searchIndex.title: Chapter 12 SIMA Methodology The Time is Now for Mindfulness “The present moment is f illed with joy and happiness
searchIndex.text: IQ is like the logical intelligence and knowledge that we have. EQ are the social skills that allow you to express your emotions and ideas effectively and non-threateningly. As you might imagine, in an innovative tech company like VP.Start, team members are generally of an above average IQ . After all, they are working in areas of advanced technology. Unfortunately, in some cases, EQ lags behind which can lead to miscommunication. “A lot of people communicate, but only a few connect.” Mindfulness theory realizes that if these two forces are not in balance, it is easy for people to get offended, for team members to feel disrespected and for teamwork to break down. Meditation can be a way to remove from our own mind the unnecessary that is hampering our EQ development. Facing our own story honestly, can also be helpful in EQ improvement. EQ takes practice as does all communication and these training sessions are a great opportunity to get in touch with impediments to our own EQ growth. Are your IQ and EQ in balance as much as you would like? Why would it be beneficial to you if your IQ and EQ were more balanced? Finally, the mindfulness speaker focused on the importance of developing good habits . One such habit that he particularly emphasized was being on time. He warned the class that tardiness would not be tolerated . “What you tolerate, you teach.” Anyone arriving late would be denied admission. This may seem a bit harsh on the surface but in mindfulness theory, this is absolutely indispensable. 379 Why? As he stated, what you do now becomes what you do in the future. What you think and what you practice becomes who you are . If the habit of being late is allowed and practiced now, it will grow through hours and days, months and years of repetition. Similarly, the habit of promptness and always being on time, can be solidified in the same fashion. Think of it this way, Isn’t it better to be barred from attending a training session due to tardiness in the present and learn a pivotal if tough lesson from that experience, then to be barred from a major international conference or pitching event down the road.? Much better to learn the hard lessons when the consequences are not that severe so that you don’t need to face severe consequences at some point in the future. Are you developing the habits now that will keep you out of trouble in the future? Are you adopting habits that will make you more productive or less productive in the long haul? Let me ask you a question. How productive are you? No judgment. Feel free to answer honestly. Assuming you work an eight hour day as most people do, how many hours are spent in actual productivity? How many hours are wasted in less than productive ways? In the training session, 380

searchIndex.title: Chapter 12 SIMA Methodology The Time is Now for Mindfulness “The present moment is f illed with joy and happiness
searchIndex.text: team member answers ranged from 1 to 6 hours of productivity a day . If we are brutally honest, I think most of us are closer to the smaller number than the larger one. Does this mean that we are all lazy workers trying to avoid accomplishing anything? I don’t think so, at least, not in most cases. We are not mindful. We are not perfectly clear as to what we must be doing at this moment. It is not a problem of scheduling and prioritizing, per se, although these can be issues as well. It is a problem of not being in the current moment, not being fully focused on what we are doing now. Meditation and mindfulness theory seek to give us that concentration. Would you like to be more productive? I know I would! Some of you may have read this chapter and thought to yourself that this topic is more about ideology than methodology. You are not completely wrong in thinking this. But in the SIMA Journey, while we divide things into Story, Ideology, Methodology and Amazing Innovation, they all are deeply and profoundly connected. We cannot perfectly separate them into distinct parts. I made the choice to include this in the methodology section because of the strategic value invested in mindfulness training by Phally. He realizes that any sustainability system can only be built on the foundation of a productive, mindful team . As already mentioned, considerable time and financial resources have been deployed to bring this training to the entire team. You might think that at a time when VP.Start is becoming busier and busier and as the SIMA Journey is scaling up, 381 ramping up and speeding up, there would be no time to “waste” on mindfulness training. But Phally has the exact opposite opinion. As VP.Start becomes more and more powerful and the SIMA Journey becomes more and more global, there is no chance of success without increased concentration. Increased focus. Increased productivity through increased mindfulness. How important is it for you to gain increased concentration, focus and productivity through mindfulness? Are you ready to make mindfulness a pivotal part of your journey as well? 382

searchIndex.text: Chapter 1 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Innovation is the Result, Not the Starting Point “It does not matter how slow you go as long as you do not stop.” -Confucius, Chinese philosopher We have just stated in the introduction to this section that everyone should be an innovator, can be an innovator, was born to be an innovator. While we believe that this is absolutely true, it doesn’t take long to look at people and see that many of them, perhaps, most of them, are not creative, they are not innovators, they are not producing amazing innovations. There are two possibilities: Either our theory is wrong and we were not born to be innovators OR something is blocking and hindering many people from becoming innovators. Are you the innovator that you want to be? Are you creating and developing the amazing innovations that you want to create? If the answer is “NO” , in your opinion, what is holding you back and hindering you? VP.Start knows that innovation is the result of a process. Do you know that, as well? 393 Innovation is the outcome, not the starting point. If there are any disruptions or blockages along the way to innovation, as if there were a power outage in our “innovation transmission lines”, you and I will never become the innovators that we were designed and destined to be. What are the disruptions and faults that threaten to block your “innovation transmission lines”? Innovation is the natural order of the universe. Let me say that again. Innovation is the natural order of the universe. When you see a plant growing out of a crack in the road, that is innovation. Plants don’t plan or try to grow out of the cracks in the pavement. But when they face less than perfect situations, they find solutions. They innovate. A bird builds a nest out the materials that they can find. They are not always the most optimal materials. Birds can’t go to the store to buy “nest materials”. If a bird cannot find the perfect materials to build a nest, they innovate with the materials that they can find. They are innovators and we are innovators because that is the fundamental principle of nature. VP.Start adopted the principle, the universally natural principle of innovation, from the time that VP.Start was just an idea in the mind of a young Phally. Remember, the first step in the innovative process called the SIMA Journey is to know your story, 394

searchIndex.title: Chapter 1 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Innovation is the Result, Not the Starting Point “It does not matter how slow you go as long as you do not stop
searchIndex.text: to accept your story, to learn from your story. Stories are not always good or always bad. It goes without saying that there are successes and failures, honors and humiliations, victories and losses. When we look squarely and unhesitatingly at our personal catastrophes, we are empowered to become innovators. Are you empowering yourself to become an innovator? If you don’t empower yourself, who do you expect to do it for you? As we saw in the SIMA Story section of our book, Phally and VP.Start were not always successful. Phally grew up in poverty in a small village with very limited access to education . He was very poor at and uninterested in math until the age of 12. When he first started to have explosive growth in his math skills, this also perturbed his teachers who didn’t always appreciate the chaos that he brought to the classroom , Phally’s refusal to follow instructions because “there must be a better way” to answer each of the homework problems and his bold defense of his opinions to his teachers. For instance, at one point, even when he was threatened with getting a “0” on his exam because of his poor attitude, he informed the teacher that he didn’t care about scores and marks anyway. These early experiences of Phally’s set the stage for him to become an innovator . 395 He learned to be resilient in the face of daunting challenges. He learned that when he is interested in something he can learn rapidly but when he is not interested in a topic or doesn’t see the purpose, he won’t learn it in a 1000 years. He learned that he did not care about the approval of others and he was happy to break the rules even if it made some people unhappy. He learned that teachers, textbooks and experts were not always right . What are you learning from your past experiences that are making you a better innovator? These are absolutely indispensable lessons for an innovator. If you are not resilient, you will never become an innovator. If you care too much about the approval others or their validation, you will never become an innovator. If you are afraid to or unwilling to break the rules with intention, y ou will never become an innovator. If you are not bold enough to stand up for your ideas when “experts” criticize you, you will never become an innovator. After founding VP.Start on the ideals of innovation, the young company experienced many more challenges and successes on the road to innovation. Team members that decided to leave and take internal, confidential information with them. Investors who said that they loved VP.Start’s SIMA Journey but declined to invest. Government officials, 396

searchIndex.title: Chapter 1 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Innovation is the Result, Not the Starting Point “It does not matter how slow you go as long as you do not stop
searchIndex.text: academic leaders and international supporters who saw the potential of the VP.Start ecosolutions even though they did not understand these solutions. Because of the powerful voice of VP.Start, they FBRed (felt, believed and remembered) these solutions. Again, the story and experiences of VP.Start offered up valuable lessons to the upstart company on what it takes to become an innovator and to stay an innovator. If you cannot overcome disappointment , betrayal and ungrateful ex-team members, you should never try to become an innovator. If you are not willing to raise a powerful, passionate, positive voice on behalf of your innovations, you should never try to become an innovator. Our Story is sometimes outside of our control. Where we are born, what kind of parents we have, what kind of education we receive, many of these things are not determined by us as individuals. But how we react to our Story, namely our Ideology, is much more under our control. How have you reacted to your Story, your hardships and your moments of glory? Have you and I always reacted in the way that an innovator would react? One reason that many potential innovators never become actual innovators stems from their philosophical approaches, their Ideology. 397 It doesn’t matter what your story was, good or bad, if you don’t have the innovator’s mindset and ideology, you will never become the innovator that you were born to be. Some of the core philosophies of VP.Start include: there is nothing wrong with making mistakes, we learn more from failures than successes, we must grow or die, we need to know the rules so we can break them well, we must develop a powerful voice, and we must learn and strive to become ourselves. Let me brutally candid with you, dear reader. If you are afraid of making mistakes or not prepared to embrace failures as learning experiences, you would do well to avoid becoming an innovator. If you are not enthusiastic about growing above all else, you would do well to discontinue becoming an innovator. If you want to live within the rules, inside the box, in the comfort zone, you would do well to reconsider becoming an innovator. If you don’t feel inclined to work hard to develop your powerful voice (and it is hard work), you should abandon becoming an innovator. If you are not bold enough and arrogant enough to value yourself and become yourself, you should never consider becoming an innovator. NEVER. Even if you face your Story bravely and honestly AND build an Ideology that is focused on innovation, if your methodology is faulty , 398

searchIndex.title: Chapter 1 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Innovation is the Result, Not the Starting Point “It does not matter how slow you go as long as you do not stop
searchIndex.text: you will never become an innovator. Many people make it this far, but most sadly, they fail at this point in the process and they do not become the innovators that they should be. Whereas your Story is in the past and impossible to change AND your Ideology is similarly established over time and solidified, your Methodology can be changing all the time depending on situations and data. It should be changing if you are an innovator. Are you constantly and continuously changing your methodologies as needed in the pursuit of innovation? For VP.Start, our methodology revolves around a number of methodological principles: implementing strict cybersecurity, promoting adoption of renewable energy, building grid and IoT solutions that are affordable across the developing world, harnessing AI ethically, employing digital twin technology for improved consumer and utility outcomes and strengthening the internal team with meditation and other mindfulness techniques. You cannot build an innovative company if data is not protected strenuously . You cannot build an innovative company if renewable energy is not adopted proactively . You cannot build an innovative company if Smart Grid and IoT solutions are not created affordably. 399 You cannot build an innovative company if AI capabilities are leveraged unethically and improperly. You cannot build an innovative company if digital twin technology is not applied benefi cially. You cannot build an innovative company if the internal team is not empowered regularly . You cannot build an innovative company UNLESS you are willing to upgrade methodology constantly . Story, Ideology and Methodology can seem like three obstacles that potential innovators must navigate and surpass but actually, I wouldn’t recommend that you see it in that way. Th ese are three guideposts to help you fi nd your way to innovation. If you are not the innovator that you want to be, let me ask you three questions: 1) Have you ever really considered your Story honestly and gained insights from it? 2) Have you adopted an ideology that will allow you to become a true innovator? 3) Have you reimagined your methodology repeatedly to align it with your innovative goals? When you are able to honestly, proudly and unfl inchingly answer “YES” to all three questions , you won’t need to try to become an innovator. You are already one. Just be yourself! 400

searchIndex.title: Chapter 2 SIMA Amazing Innovations: Ecosolutions for Ecoproblems “The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it
searchIndex.text: Chapter 2 SIMA Amazing Innovations: Ecosolutions for Ecoproblems “The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it.” -Robert Swan, polar explorer and environmentalist At VP.Start, we never talk about products. We always talk about solutions. Ecosolutions. Products can be something we need but they can also be something we don’t need. Solutions are different than products. We always need solutions …if we really understand the problems. Do you think in terms of solutions or in terms of products? Why does this make a crucial difference in your approach? The first step for VP.Start or anyone else, in creating amazing solutions, is understanding the problems . There are no ecosolutions until we understand, fathom deeply, the ecoproblems that we are facing. Some of the problems are easy and obvious to see, like pollution and climate change. Others might be more subtle and easier not to notice like the digital divide or lack of electrical access in remote, rural areas. But we can see all the ecoproblems clearly WHEN we look at the data . Do you have a clear, data-based understanding of the problems that you are trying to solve? 401 It is outside the scope of this book to look deeply into the various problems and challenges that are facing our planet in terms of sustainability. There are already many excellent books in each of these areas. We want to focus on the amazing innovations , the ecosolutions, that VP.Start is bringing to bear on some of these serious challenges. It is important to note that in most cases, these global challenges are not isolated and separate but they are directly interconnected . Just like sustainability is part of the big picture of overarching transformation, similarly the challenges that we face also form a tapestry connected together. In other words, just as we cannot create a true sustainability system one piece at a time or in one country at a time , we also cannot solve any one of these problems without solving the others, simultaneously. Needless to say, this is a daunting task, a herculean task, indeed. Since many challenges are interconnected, do you have an overarching strategy to create solutions or are you trying to solve the massive problems piece by piece? One of the challenges that our world faces is climate change and weather disruption. It is not for this book to discuss whether climate change is purely man made or if it has a natural component, as well. Suffice it to say that increasingly unpredictable weather, including flooding, forest fires, accelerated desertification and coastal erosion are serious issues that directly impact the energy sector and energy transmission and distribution. 402

searchIndex.title: Chapter 2 SIMA Amazing Innovations: Ecosolutions for Ecoproblems “The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it
searchIndex.text: They directly affect the SIMA Journey. Does the challenge of climate change impact your innovative solutions? Obviously, the energy transition movement is connected to this climate change problem. More and more resources are being spent on upgrading recycling, reducing pollution and integrating more renewable energy into the overall power system. Again, to state the obvious, these challenges directly impact an innovative tech company in the energy sector like VP.Start. Are you and your solutions involved in the energy transition? If not, why not? Related to the energy transition, there is also a move to increase efficient use of resources . Whether we are talking about more traditional fossil fuels or nuclear power or renewables or other sources, we want to make sure that these resources are not wasted and are used in a way that is efficient, cost-effective and sustainable. The recent geopolitical situation in the Middle East has made this necessity even more crystal clear. Once again, as you can surely see, this increases the need for ecosolutions from innovative companies such as VP.Start. Another area that is connected to all of the previous challenges, is the worldwide digital transformation . 403 More and more processes are being digitized , operations are being automated , business plans are being generated by AI. This can be a very positive development but unfortunately, a digital divide comes along with this benefit. Countries with access to ample electricity that is affordable and reliable are well suited to take full advantage of the move to a digital world. However, in regions, countries and even continents, where electric service is rare, expensive and undependable, or where does not exist at all, the digital transformation will be slow if it happens at all. This is a very direct challenge to the SIMA Journey goal of a more sustainable future for our world. One more major challenge, although this is not to say that there are not many other challenges, is workforce development for the future , including education and training. As we move towards a more technically advanced future with more digitization, more AI infusion, more IoT adoption, more renewables generation and more carbon emission reduction, we will need a workforce with radically different skills than are currently available. Can our educational institutions keep up with the pace of transformative technological advancements? Will our future workforce have the creativity, resilience, positivity and passion to keep going forwards? VP.Start realizes that this is no small challenge , by any means. What kind of workforce development will be necessary for you to 404

searchIndex.title: Chapter 2 SIMA Amazing Innovations: Ecosolutions for Ecoproblems “The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it
searchIndex.text: achieve your innovative dreams? Having looked at 5 serious dilemmas for our world, VP.Start felt compelled to create ecosolutions. The SIMA Journey does not allow for ignoring problems or hoping that the problems go away. Remember, the more deeply we understand and experience the problem, the better solution we will be able to bring to the table. If you think that someone else will solve the problem, you are a part of the problem. Are you compelled to find solutions or just motivated to sell products? Different motivations have different outcomes. Returning to the volatile issue of climate change , this problem directly impacts VP.Start’s grid modernization and sustainability solutions , like the DRC, SIMA Smart City IoT sensors and SIMA Smart Home and office automation IoT solutions. Rising temperatures, especially in a country that is already quite hot and humid like Cambodia, can wreak havoc on sensitive equipment and drastically diminish transmission lines carrying capacity. Extreme weather events like flooding can damage substations, compromise digital communication and destroy IoT sensors and smart switches. Of course, the SIMA Journey does not claim to have all the answers to the climate change question. This is a highly complicated and complex situation, requiring research and planning across a wide variety of sectors. Still, VP.Start recognizes that one of the most powerful ways to reduce 405 our carbon footprint and improve environmental outcomes is by making the grid more efficient. That is what the ecosolutions of VP.Start are already accomplishing in Cambodia and now are starting to accomplish, in Laos, as well. A more efficient grid means less leakages, energy loss and fewer outages, all of which reduce the carbon footprint. A more efficient grid means less waste from power generation to distribution to consumption, which also reduces the carbon footprint . Finally, a more efficient grid means less unnecessary generation of power, which greatly reduces the carbon footprint. No one is claiming that these ecosolutions will completely solve the challenges inherent in climate change overnight. But VP.Start is very proud that the solutions that they have created in the SIMA Journey are promoting a big step in the right direction. Are you innovative ideas helping people take a step in the right direction? Are you promoting your “steps in the right direction” in a way to accelerate them? The energy transition and specifically the greater adoption of renewables in the overall power system is a key priority of the Cambodian government. It benefits the kingdom in terms of reducing waste, decreasing the carbon footprint, improving environmental outcomes and diminishing dependence on overseas energy sources. These are lofty goals and they are shared by many other countries all across the globe. But these are not objectives that are easy to achieve. 406

searchIndex.title: Chapter 2 SIMA Amazing Innovations: Ecosolutions for Ecoproblems “The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it
searchIndex.text: As you know, renewable energy like solar and wind power are intermittent in nature. Some days there is an ample supply of power but on other days, they are insufficient. Even hydroelectricity is somewhat intermittent , especially in Southeast Asian countries and other areas where there are rainy and dry seasons. Also, using current technology, renewable power is limited in scope and not yet ready to meet the full demand of energy consumers, factories, businesses and eventually, AI Data Centers. How do we integrate more renewable energy without disrupting power service or reducing power reliability? This is where the data-driven solutions of VP.Start, created in the SIMA Journey, are so essential. Using acquired data, operators are able to make the grid more flexible, integrating renewables as much as possible when possible, storing excess generated renewable power in battery energy storage systems for later use and when renewable power in insufficient, rapidly transitioning to other energy sources . Power flow is not disrupted. Power reliability is not diminished. The power system is more sustainable. And in the near future, the whole process will be automated to make these decision instantly. Once again, this is not an overnight solution but it is another example of the ecosolutions generated by the SIMA Journey moving us in the right direction . Concerning the challenge of using resources more efficiently , this is exactly what VP.Start is promoting and striving for with all its might. 407 A Smart grid based on data, dynamically digitized and infused with AI capabilities for advanced automation will be a grid that uses precious resources in the wisest way possible, based on countless simulation and scenario testings. Of course, these data-driven ecosolutions will continue to improve our response to climate change and the energy transition, as well. And, these solutions are designed to be exported and employed in countries all over the world, especially in the developing world. As the ecosolutions are spread more and more widely across the world, giving more and more people access to reliable electricity, grid modernization and the SIMA ecosolutions, the digital divide will inevitably be decreased , as well. Cambodia is a developing country so we can easily sympathize with other countries that are struggling to modernize their energy sectors. We want to bring our solutions, with creative pricing strategies , to improve their situations. Finally, there is the question of a quality, highly skilled workforce able to tackle these challenges. That is why VP.Start has made educational outreach a major part of its SIMA Journey. Working directly with a large of high schools and universities, in Cambodia and abroad, creating internships and mentorships for skilled and dedicated students, signing MoUs with various educational institutions and governmental organizations to increase alignment, funding research programs at various schools and hosting frequent workshops for students to upgrade their creative thinking : 408

Needless to say, none of these challenges will be easy to solve. Some progress will be made but a complete solution may have to be left to future generations. Nonetheless, we are proud to say that for each interconnected problem , we have been able to create interconnected solutions . We see the problems. We see the solutions. We see the future and we see it now! At the end of the day, there are really only two choices: You can be part of the problem OR You can be part of the solution. So, what is your choice? 409 410 408

searchIndex.title: Chapter 3 SIMA Amazing Innovations: The Overarching Sustainability System “Sustainability is no longer about doing less harm
searchIndex.text: Chapter 3 SIMA Amazing Innovations: The Overarching Sustainability System “Sustainability is no longer about doing less harm. It is about doing more good.” -Jochen Zeitz, former CEO of Puma and Harley Davidson In this book, you have seen one word many times. Sustainability. It really doesn’t make sense to talk about VP.Start or the SIMA Journey unless we talk about sustainability . What kind of sustainable future do you envision? How do your innovations bring us closer to that outcome? We have also talked several times about the five missions of the SIMA Journey . Each mission: SIMA Smart Grid, SIMA Cities, SIMA Homes, the SIMA Universe (the UCN, AlienCheck) and SIMA Big Data are vitally important. That’s why a chapter or more will be dedicated to the innovations each of the missions. And yet, in some ways, talking about the five missions is a bit of a misnomer. In fact, there is only one VP.Start. VP.Start only has one SIMA Journey. 411 AND the SIMA Journey only has one mission. Sustainability. This is not a technical detail. This is absolutely critical to understanding the SIMA Journey. Each of the missions succeed if they are part of the overall sustainability system and play a role in creating a comprehensively sustainable future. On the other hand, if any of the missions become isolated and disconnected from the overarching sustainability system, t hey just become products to be sold. If that happens, VP.Start will become a product-driven, profits-driven highly conventional company with many competitors, no innovative vision and no distinctions from other tech and engineering companies. Fortunately, that will NEVER happen. The five missions will stay together as one sustainability system because they MUST converge to forge a sustainable future. Otherwise, they are basically meaningless. Allow me to elucidate. The SIMA Smart Grid is the foundation upon which all five missions are built. The Smart Grid provides reliable, dependable electricity, among other benefits. Electricity when we need it, where we need it. After all, what good is a Smart City that has frequent outages and power loss? 412

searchIndex.title: Chapter 3 SIMA Amazing Innovations: The Overarching Sustainability System “Sustainability is no longer about doing less harm
searchIndex.text: What is the point of Smart Home and Office automation if the power source is so unreliable that it doesn’t work most of the time? What benefit can we gain from AlienCheck if the WiFi and Internet connection is always going down? What is the chance of taking advantage of SIMA Big Data if data acquisition and simulations are regularly collapsing due to an undependable power supply? Yes, without the SIMA Smart Grid, there are no fivefold missions of the SIMA Journey. Why do your innovative ideas and solutions depend on reliable power? Why is a reliable source of power essential and mission critical BUT insufficient on it own? Ok, so let’s say, we do have a data-driven and AI-infused digital SIMA Smart Grid in place. In hand. Energy is being provided regularly and consistently, affordably and effectively. And yet this power is not being employed to make city life better. There is: no upgrade in garbage collection and storage, no improvement in traffic management, no advancement in weather forecasting, no progress in public transportation, no amelioration of building safety, no augmentation of security systems, no positive developments in water management or, indeed, no success stories in any other area of the urban experience. The SIMA Smart Grid is providing reliable power but it is not ameliorating the city life. How is this sustainable? How can we call this “sustainability”? 413 Furthermore, without the Smart City Initiatives, a large amount of IoT data is not being generated and gathered, data which could have been used in other aspects of the SIMA Journey five missions as well. Without a sustainable approach to cities, there is no true sustainability. Do your creative ideas and innovative solutions improve the lives of city dwellers? Do these ideas help to create better urban outcomes and more positive experiences? Ok, let’s take this a step further. Let’s say that there is a powerful and efficient AI-infused data-driven digital SIMA Smart Grid up and functioning AND there are also a number of IoT-based SIMA Smart City solutions implemented, additionally, to improve city life. But, there is no effort being made to move these IoT solutions into homes, offices, factories and other living spaces and workplaces. The solutions are in the streets but not in the homes. It is a better situation than no IoT usage at all, to be sure, but it is still not truly sustainable. How can we talk about a sustainable future if it does not improve our daily lives? SIMA Home is actually the mission among the five which comes closest to most of us. The SIMA Smart Grid seems important in theory, but unless we are electrical engineers or grid operators, we don’t have much direct contact with it or deep understanding of it. The SIMA City Intiatives bring IoT closer to us as they improve our lives as city dwellers when we leave our homes and venture out into the world. 414

searchIndex.title: Chapter 3 SIMA Amazing Innovations: The Overarching Sustainability System “Sustainability is no longer about doing less harm
searchIndex.text: But the SIMA Home and Office Initiatives bring the power of IoT automation directly into daily contact with us at the closest levels. When we eat meals. When we take a shower. When we perform basic work tasks. When we sleep and wake up. Do your amazing innovations provide benefits to people in their daily lives? In their workday situations and in their regular, day-to-day home lives? How do your ideas connect to ordinary people living ordinary lives in the modern world? OK, then, let’s keep going. Let’s say we have the first three missions all working together effectively. We have a SIMA Smart Grid for reliable power , SIMA Cities for better urban outcomes and SIMA Home and Office automation for more productive work and more comfortable home lives . Is this enough for a full sustainability system? VP.Start would say, NO! What is still lacking? We need to have access to the information, the data , of the our home, office and city automation initiatives. Knowledge is power. Let me repeat that. Knowledge is power. We need that powerful knowledge in our own hands. We need to manage our own data 415 so we can reduce our own waste, increase our own productivity and diminish our own expenses. Not leveraged or harnessed by others. We should be in charge of our own data. Making our own data-driven decisions. The UCN, AlienCheck, makes that possible. It also adds AI capabilities and conversational features so we can make wisely informed decisions. AlienCheck ties the three previous missions together in one app, so we can interface with the entire sustainability system effectively. How do you combine your ideas into one logical, overarching framework? How do you make your innovations converge into one big picture solution? One journey? Ok, let’s take it to the next logical step. Let’s say we have a reliable and dependable source or energy thanks to the SIMA Smart Grid , we have better city life courtesy of the SIMA City Initiatives , we have improved home and office outcomes due to SIMA Home automation AND we have a universal connectivity app, AlienCheck that helps us connect seamlessly to all of these missions, making us participants and not just spectators. This MUST be enough for a sustainability system, right? VP.Start says that this is still not sufficient. Still inadequate. We need the final piece . 416

searchIndex.title: Chapter 3 SIMA Amazing Innovations: The Overarching Sustainability System “Sustainability is no longer about doing less harm
searchIndex.text: The final component. We need SIMA Big Data, the final mission . What is the benefit of collecting data from the power grid by the DRC series and other equipment if we don’t use that data to improve grid operations? What good are IoT sensors of the deployed in the SIMA Smart City if that data gathered is not being utilized, in real-time, to make changes, improvements and accelerated growth? What is the advantage of having SIMA Home or Office automation if that data is not being used effectively to improve the function of appliance while reducing the cost of their usage? Especially, what is the purpose of AlienCheck if data is not being generated, collected, monitored, cleansed, analyzed, simulated, tested and applied in an endless cycle? Without data, AlienCheck becomes little more than a social media app with AI functions, not worth the trouble of downloading. But, when we are able to combine a highly dependable and affordable SIMA Smart Grid with SIMA Smart City solutions improving our cities and SIMA Home automation enhancing our work and home lives while the SIMA Universe , AlienCheck makes all of this data accessible at our fingertips AND SIMA Big Data makes sure that all of these missions are data-driven and continuously, relentlessly upgrading themselves, we have started to achieve an overarching and comprehensive sustainability system . How well are you leveraging and harnessing the advantages that 417 accrue from Big Data? What could you be doing to ensure that your amazing innovations take full advantage of Big Data? After accomplishing those five missions simultaneously, all that remains is to spread it all over Cambodia and then to spread it all over the ASEAN region and then to spread it all over the developing world and then to spread it all over the planet. True sustainability comes when sustainability comes to everyone. Sustainability that leaves anyone out is not true sustainability. Are your ideas ready to spread and become viral? Is the world waiting for your amazing innovations? Do your creative solutions leave anyone out or leave anyone behind? Of course, you can say that building this kind of universal sustainability is impossible . Too many geopolitical problems. Too many logistical problems. Too many manpower problems. The problems are too big and the time is too short . Yes, of course, you are right, if you think that way. But as we noted before, VP.Start and CEO Phally love impossible challenges. Phally has often said that “ if it is not impossible, it is not worth trying. ” What impossible challenges are you trying to overcome with your amazing innovations? Do the daunting challenges make you afraid or make you more 418

searchIndex.title: Chapter 3 SIMA Amazing Innovations: The Overarching Sustainability System “Sustainability is no longer about doing less harm
searchIndex.text: audacious and more arrogant? You might also say that it is crazy for a relatively small and young company like VP.Start in a developing country with a team of around 100 members and an expanding but still small campus and a growing but still not so large revenue base to try to tackle a problem this large and daunting and complex. Once again, you are not wrong to think so, I suppose. But CEO Phally would respond that success or failure does NOT depend on the size of the team or the size of the campus or the size of the budget . Th ey ONLY depend on the size of the ideas . Nothing more and nothing less. Big companies NEVER change the world. Big ideas ALWAYS do. Are you ideas big enough to impact the world positively? searchIndex.title: Chapter 4 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Grid Modernization from Cambodia, for the World “The key to unlocking sustainability is affordable, reliable electric power” -CEO Phally Where do amazing innovations come from? They come from a deep, transformative understanding of problems, challenges, predicaments
searchIndex.text: Chapter 4 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Grid Modernization from Cambodia, for the World “The key to unlocking sustainability is affordable, reliable electric power” -CEO Phally Where do amazing innovations come from? They come from a deep, transformative understanding of problems, challenges, predicaments. VP.Start’s team has experienced the drawbacks of the conventional grid professionally and personally . Professionally , as it has slowed down production and testing of new solutions. Personally , as it has made daily tasks like cooking and cleaning inconvenient. Professionally , as it has caused missed deadlines, failed projects and decreased profits. Personally , as it has made simple tasks like doing homework much more difficult for kids. Professionally , as it has decelerated research and diminished marketing success. Personally , as it has made hot dry season and wet rainy seasons less easy to bear. It turns out that both professionally and personally , we all depend on a dependable source of electric power. In the modern world, everything runs on electricity and when electricity is unavailable or unreliable, everything does not run well. Are your innovative ideas and creative solutions based on real world problems? 421 Are you trying to navigate obstacles that people face or just sell products and services? When VP.Start was first formed as a company, first registered, and even long before that, when VP.Start was still just an idea in Phally’s head, there was a clear goal, an absolutely unshakable objective . Cambodia must have a reliable energy supply . Effective education depends on electricity . Safe medical care depends on electricity . Tourism depends on electricity . Agriculture depends on electricity . Governmental control depends on electricity . Law and order and security depend on electricity . International investment depends on electricity . Literally, everything depends on electricity. If you have always lived in country that has an ample supply of electricity, it may be hard for you to imagine what it is like to live with unreliable, undependable electric power. Think about international investment for a moment, for example. Countries that struggle to maintain consistent electric power will have a very difficult time garnering foreign investment. And countries that fail to garner international investment will face a difficult challenge to build a reliable energy grid. You need investment for reliable power AND you need reliable power for investment. This is a vicious cycle that is very hard to break out of. A cycle that is hard to break. But not impossible to break . VP.Start has already shown that. 422

searchIndex.title: Chapter 4 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Grid Modernization from Cambodia, for the World “The key to unlocking sustainability is affordable, reliable electric power” -CEO Phally Where do amazing innovations come from? They come from a deep, transformative understanding of problems, challenges, predicaments
searchIndex.text: Some problems are very intractable and almost impossible to solve. Do you have solutions that are willing and proud to take on “impossible” challenges? From the very beginning, from the Very Powerful start, the SIMA Journey has been focused on grid modernization . This is the foundation of everything that VP.Start does. The foundation of the sustainability system. Let me ask you a few question to help unlock our thinking about the SIMA Smart Grid, the flagship innovation of VP.Start. Why do we need to overhaul the power grid system and build a SIMA Smart Grid? We must start with the current reality. We at VP.Start admit that Cambodia’s energy network is aging and has been unstable and wasteful in the past. This damages our economy in many ways. We realize that necessary renewable energy integration can cause volatility in ways that a conventional grid is unable to cope with. We acknowledge that conventional grid modernization is slow and expensive and unsuitable for developing and emerging countries that struggle to pay for expensive upgrades. We regret that consumers lack information and that grid often lacks transparency. Sadly, most consumers have limited information about their electric bills and energy usage. We adamantly insist that these problems are ubiquitous world-wide. These are not problems unique to Cambodia. 423 Not at all. Have you gained a clear picture of the current situation so you know what challenges your innovations face and what issues they are trying to address? Do you need greater clarity and data in these areas? Why are the SIMA Smart Grid solutions the best way to address these pain points? Our SIMA Smart Grid transforms the conventional grid into an adaptive ecosystems that change as data changes, that absorb fluctuations and volatility and that becomes resilient due to predictive use of data. Our SIMA Smart Grid harnesses AI and digital twins for constant upgrades which means that challenging issues such as battery energy storage usage and renewable integration become smooth, efficient and streamlined. Our SIMA Smart Grid balances power supply and demand to minimize outages. Outages can be made rare occurances if actionable data determines decisions. In this way, o ur SIMA Smart Grid facilitates renewable energy source integration seamlessly. Our SIMA Smart Grid spearheads grid modernization, streamlines the process of modernization and obtains 150% to 200% of return on investment, according to our research. Our SIMA Smart Grid reduces waste, increases efficiency and saves money. Sustainability. Actually, let me clarify one point. The SIMA Grid is not really “Our SIMA Smart Grid”. 424

searchIndex.title: Chapter 4 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Grid Modernization from Cambodia, for the World “The key to unlocking sustainability is affordable, reliable electric power” -CEO Phally Where do amazing innovations come from? They come from a deep, transformative understanding of problems, challenges, predicaments
searchIndex.text: This moniker is a bit misleading. Yes, it is our proprietary innovation, created by VP.Start in-house, by our team of local engineers and tech professionals but the SIMA Smart Grid belongs to all of us. ALL OF US. We have installed more than 10,000 DRC series devices across the grid in all regions of Cambodia, accumulating data, sharing this data to the RPM Grid or the PLUM app for visualization , making the situation of the grid clear and easily accessible through the data. Let’s be clear that the grid is not completely smart yet, but it is getting smarter all the time . We are not resting on our laurels but we well on our way to creating a true SIMA Smart Grid that gathers actionable intelligence to promote intelligent actions . We are no longer satisf ied just to know the current state of the grid but we want to use data to be predictive and proactive. We are no longer satisfied to reduce outages and handle anomalies and solve faults. We insist on finding, diagnosing and treating problems with data-driven 425 solutions BEFORE they happen. We at VP.Start have created and developed plug and play, easy to install, intuitive solutions . If solutions like the DRC were difficult to install or complicated to use, the adoption of these solutions would be tamped down and limited. But, please remember that VP.Start is a company that loves to make complicated ideas simple and challenging operations streamlined and easy. The DRC solutions do not require a lot of time to install, usually less than 15 minutes. The RPM Grid does not require advanced technical skills and jargon to operate. The PLUM app does not require you to be in a fixed location to monitor and manage the grid. Simple to use. Easy to understand. Putting tomorrow’s technology at your fingertips today. Do your amazing innovations help make people more proactive and productive? Are they easy to use, easy to manage, easy to understand and easy to benefit from? We at VP.Start have leveraged existing infrastructure to dramatically reduce costs. As we mentioned, garnering international investment for grid modernization in developing countries can be a very challenging process. At the same time, governments in emerging countries face tight budgetary constraints 426

searchIndex.text: and fiscal limitations. Traditional grid modernization is excessively expensive, usually involving wholesale rebuilding of the grid infrastructure. Time consuming. Resources consuming. Budget consuming. Manpower consuming. VP.Start had the revolutionary and radically innovative idea of leveraging existing infrastructure, using data to verify and extend infrastructure lifespans and creating amazing innovations that were amazingly cheap to purchase. Saving money without reducing quality of service. The power of creativity. Are your innovations both amazingly effective and amazingly inexpensive? We at VP.Start have worked extensively with the EDC and various electric licensees across Cambodia in every province to make the grid more extensive, make it smarter, make it more renewables-friendly, make it more affordable and make it efficient and sustainable. We are already moving these solutions into the Laotian and other international markets. What will we at VP.Start do next? We have already made considerable progress towards a SIMA Smart Grid but we are certainly not feeling complacent or satisfied . Each success reminds us of the distance we still need to cover in order 427 to reach our true destination, a truly “SIMA Smart” Grid. We at VP.Start will keep extending, updating, enhancing and expanding the Smart Grid until we achieve full Smart Grid coverage . From 10,000 DRC devices to more than 1M. From Cambodia and Laos to ASEAN and the wider world. From limited smart grid solutions to a completely intelligent grid. We want SAIDI (the duration of power outages) to be so short and SAIFI (the frequency of power outages) to be so rare that young Cambodians will hardly remember what a power outage is. We at VP.Start will reimagine the grid as a Dynamic Digital Smart Grid with software solutions. The next step in the SIMA Smart Grid journey of innovation is creating software solutions that turn the DRC series from hardware that must be manually installed in a physical location into digital solutions that can be downloaded from anywhere to anywhere at anytime by anyone . Ultimately all over the world. This Dynamic Digital Smart Grid will be able to make decisions based on actionable data remotely, instantly and increasingly, automatically. We at VP.Start will fully implement and leverage digital twin technology to improve grid function continuously. As we gather grid data through the DRC series, we will build a replica of the entire grid, allowing our team to test issues in the grid that would be too costly, dangerous or time-consuming to test in the real world. 428

searchIndex.title: Chapter 4 SIMA Amazing Innovation: Grid Modernization from Cambodia, for the World “The key to unlocking sustainability is affordable, reliable electric power” -CEO Phally Where do amazing innovations come from? searchIndex.text: We can turn data into insights, insights into actions and actions into new data to start the process over again. Endless upgrades. Pursued relentlessly. We will inaugurate an AI-infused data-driven dynamic digital SIMA Smart Grid. Now that we have created a SIMA Smart grid that is data-driven for constant upgrades, digital twin supported for testing and decision making, digital and dynamic for remote installation and monitoring, we need to inject AI into the process, making it fully automated and reducing decision making to milliseconds.
