searchIndex.text: We at VP.Start have empowered citizens to proactively manage their own energy. Great results, but insufficient. We want: greater accessibility to data, greater understanding by consumers, greater proactivity and productivity We have already started exporting these solutions to the wider world. Great results, but insufficient. We will not stop until our Smart Grid benefi ts everyone. We are creating sustainability. No one left behind. Most companies are satisfi ed with great . VP.Start insists on greater . You are an innovator. You were born to be one. You deserve to be one. You have every reason and every ability that you need to become one. The people who change the world are always succeeding but are never satisfied. Let’s embrace AI’s power while staying true to what makes us human- our creativity, empathy and problem-solving skills.” -Enamul Haque, author of bestselling books on Artifi cial Intelligence Th e SIMA Journey is based on the convergence of logical thinking, creative thinking and positive thinking, as we have discussed before. We can think about these three in a different way. While AI cannot currently be creative and has no way to be positive, it is a powerful source of logical thinking. As a matter of fact, you can say that AI is logical thinking, taking to its highest level. No human can keep up with AI in terms of logic, information, knowledge and, of course, data. Needless to say, this is also true in terms of speed of information retrieval. Th erefore, if we want to take the SIMA Smart Grid to the highest possible level in terms of data-driven decision making as well as speed, VP.Start must infuse AI into the system. searchIndex.title: Chapter 5 SIMA Amazing Innovations: AI Meets the SIMA Smart Grid “AI is advancing, but human intelligence remains crucial for true innovation
searchIndex.text: Do they also rely on human creativity and positivity for successful implementation? The DRC solutions of VP.Start collect data from the grid and pass this data to the SCADA system, the RPM Grid , for visualization in the control center by grid operators. It can also be accessed by the PLUM app remotely, to reduce negative grid outcomes like leakages, outages and equipment failure. Data is digitized and managed by human controllers and monitors. Anomalies are discovered and fault locations are pinpointed instantly. But, unfortunately, human reactions are not instantaneous or automatic. By definition. Human monitoring includes human limitations and potentially human errors. Humans can become tired, distracted, overworked, careless. AI does not have to deal with these human conditions . How do your innovative solutions account for human error and limitation? How do you leverage AI solutions to augment rather than replace human intelligence? As AI is infused into the SIMA Smart Grid, data can be dealt w ith in milliseconds, collected and stored in a variety of formats, used for a wide variety of purposes, simultaneously and utilized predictively and proactively , not only reactively and retroactively. How can we call a grid “smart” if it lacks the “intelligence” that AI can offer? Are your ideas “smart”? Are they SIMA smart? 433 AI capabilities allow the SIMA Smart grid to adopt a totally new approach to renewables integration, infrastructure lifespan, transmission line capacity, weather forecasting, peak demand prediction and preparation, power flow control, battery integration, energy volatility and fluctuation, Distributed Energy Resources (DER) integration and an almost unlimited number of other advancements in real time. Let me give you a few examples of how adding AI to the SIMA Journey changes everything: One of the powerful methodologies of the SIMA Journey to the sustainable future is leveraging the power of renewable energy. In Cambodia, this mostly means solar energy . Integrating solar energy into the SIMA Smart Grid is absolutely critical to reducing our carbon footprint, promoting energy independence and reducing pollution, among other benefits. What if we had highly accurate weather forecasts and cumulative weather data so we could predict with a great degree of accuracy the amount of solar energy generation on any given day at any time? And, furthermore, what if we could constantly update those predictions with real-time data and information? 434

searchIndex.title: Chapter 5 SIMA Amazing Innovations: AI Meets the SIMA Smart Grid “AI is advancing, but human intelligence remains crucial for true innovation
searchIndex.text: With AI infusion into the grid and with IoT sensors gathering weather data, we are already able to do exactly that . We are able to integrate solar energy and other renewable energy sources into the grid without massive fluctuations and volatility that would disrupt or limit electric service. AI infusion lets us get the benefits of renewables while mitigating the less beneficial aspects. Simultaneously. Thank you, AI infusion. searchIndex.title: Chapter 10 SIMA Amazing Innovation: SIMA Big Data is the Big Picture “We are surrounded by data but starved for insights
searchIndex.text: Chapter 10 SIMA Amazing Innovation: SIMA Big Data is the Big Picture “We are surrounded by data but starved for insights.” -Jay Baer, Customer Experience Expert Of the 5 core missions of VP.Start, this one is probably the least understood and the least mentioned. Many people seem to think that Big Data is some mysterious concept, floating around in space. They struggle to understand concepts like digital twin technology and AI Data centers, and feel that data science is only for geniuses and masterminds. Yet, actually, truth be told, data is commonplace and has existed since the beginning of time, long before humans ever walked on this planet. How do you feel about the Big Data Revolution? Are you excited about the prospects or does it make you feel a little uneasy? Stated in the simplest terms, data is information . Your hair color is data. Your breakfast is data. Every cell in your body is functioning on data. Atoms that make up the physical universe combine and separate based on data. The planets move according to data. Data is everywhere, in everything, 471 every action, every word, every thought, every involuntary movement. While for many observers, SIMA Big Data seems daunting and unfathomable, in many ways, it is the most important of all the SIMA innovations. Grid modernization means very little if we don’t have a system to take advantage of the Big Data that we accumulate. SIMA Smart City and SIMA Smart Home similarly use data to upgrade and inform. Lacking this Big Data generating and applying power, the SIMA Smart City and SIMA Smart Home Initiatives are largely pointless. The UCN, AlienCheck, above all its other features must harness data, Big Data, or it has little reason for existence. Without SIMA Big Data, the SIMA Journey falls apart. With SIMA Big Data, the SIMA Journey moves forward towards the destination. Big Data is that critical. In terms of the SIMA Journey and the five key missions of VP.Start, when we talk about data, what exactly are we talking about? Let’s look briefly, mission by mission. In terms of the SIMA Smart Grid , VP.Start accumulates data using the DRC series of IoT-infused gadgets to determine the current state of the electric grid at any given moment . Operators can monitor the grid conditions remotely with the RPM Grid in the control center or on the PLUM app for mobile monitoring. Power flows are managed, outages are quickly pinpointed and handled, phase imbalances are coped with, 472

searchIndex.title: Chapter 10 SIMA Amazing Innovation: SIMA Big Data is the Big Picture “We are surrounded by data but starved for insights
searchIndex.text: anomalies are noted and switching and closing are performed on the lateral lines remotely, when necessary. This is the Big Data accumulation stage for the SIMA Smart Grid. By itself, this data acquisition is meaningful and helpful but it is just the beginning. Why is it absolutely essential to know the current situation before we try to make improvements? In a similar way, in the SIMA Smart City Initiatives, IoT sensors like the SCD series are deployed in middle-sized urban areas of Cambodia such as Kampong Cham and TaKhmao cities . These SCD sensors pick up data from street lights to prevent energy leakage, malfunctions and short circuits in street lighting. Furthermore, the SCD series can monitor individual light bulb capacity and lifespan and perform remote dimming or brightening as needed, to facilitate energy savings and reduce maintenance costs . This Big Data is collected by the IoT sensors and sent to the AlienCheck app. Similar sensors for SIMA Smart Waste Bins, SIMA Smart Parking, SIMA Traffic Control and Safety and SIMA Air Quality Monitors are under development currently. This will create an ever expanding amount of Big Data. How can data that you acquire help your business to facilitate energy saving and reduce maintenance costs? How important would that reduction and savings be to you and 473 your innovation? In terms of the SIMA Smart Home and Office Initiatives, the VH series of smart switches monitors power, voltage, current and energy consumption for each connected appliance or gadget. This Big Data is once again transmitted to the AlienCheck app where it can be easily accessed by consumers. Would you like to live a more data-driven and smarter home and office life? At this point, we have already seen that the SIMA Smart Grid, the SIMA Smart City and the SIMA Smart Home are all gathering data constantly and transmitting that data to the RPM Grid, the PLUM app, and especially, to the UCN of AlienCheck. This is powerful Big Data acquisition . This acquisition involves gathering data, verifying the accuracy of the data, cleansing the data, storing the data, keeping the data cybersecure and organizing the data in the data repositories so that data can be found and retrieved when needed. Is this the entire SIMA Big Data Initiative? No, not at all, not yet. After all, acquiring data is not the hardest part. Using the data in the right way, effectively, is the real challenge. If we use data ineffectively or worse still, we accumulate data but never 474

searchIndex.title: Chapter 10 SIMA Amazing Innovation: SIMA Big Data is the Big Picture “We are surrounded by data but starved for insights
searchIndex.text: use it all, data is completely worthless. We are gathering digital trash and expending a lot of money and technological effort to gather that digital trash. The SIMA Big Data initiative really starts when we start to use the data that has been acquired. We turn “garbage” data into “pure gold” data. How does VP.Start do that? Let’s look at the missions of VP.Start one more time, but this time in the context of data simulation, not data acquisition. Data simulation is the point at which we start trying to make sense of the data . Are you collecting an accumulating pure gold data or garbage data? Are you getting full benefit from the data that you spend so much time and effort to acquire? In the case of the SIMA Smart Grid, this means that we start creating digital scenarios and testing them based on the data. For example: When do we expect peaks and troughs in electric usage? Well, let’s try out a million scenarios and see which ones are supported by the data. What weather situations are most likely to cause outages? Let’s test millions of weather scenarios against the data. What time of day are energy consumers most likely to increase energy use? We may have a guess or prediction about this based on our experience but now we can use the data to disprove or support our theories and suppositions. Do you make business decisions based on guesses, assumptions and 475 theories or do you test your ideas against actual data? Are you a wild guesser or a data simulator? Simulation is not just academic theorizing, because we move these simulation results into data application where we bring these insights into practice , to bear on various problems. We determine how to react to real-time weather updates based on the simulations. We prepare for peak electric demand based on the scenarios that we have tested. We make decisions on energy allocation and renewables integration and battery energy storage or retrieval based on the results of our simulated experiments. After you apply data to a situation, how do you follow up to see if that result met your expectations? Never be satisfieed with “almost good enough.” Data does not allow that! This is not the end, of course. Each application of data creates new data to be collected and analyzed. Was our application highly accurate? Or was it flawed? Did some bias enter into our data acquisition or simulation? With the new data gathered from the applications, we restart the process of simulation again and again. Constantly getting better results. Getting closer to perfection but never getting there. Never satisfied. As VP.Start uses the SCD series of street light sensors, the same pattern is followed. How do weather patterns impact the quality of street lighting? How should we respond to the data on weather issues? How many anomalies and malfunctions do we record on average per month? 476

searchIndex.title: Chapter 10 SIMA Amazing Innovation: SIMA Big Data is the Big Picture “We are surrounded by data but starved for insights
searchIndex.text: How can we reduce those problems, based on the data? How accurate are our lifespan predicitions? How can we use data to make them more accurate? Simulate endless scenarios with data, apply these simulated solutions to the real-world, start over again with the newly gathered data. As you can imagine, the SIMA Smart Home follows exactly the same pattern of data collection, data simulation, and data application which generates new data to be collected. The Big Data Cycle. How can you leverage the Big Data Cycle for your benefit instead of it leveraging you? As VP.Start gathers more and more data about the Smart Grid and as it becomes more accurate, we are gradually creating a digital representation, a replica of the SIMA Smart Grid in its entirety. This is called a digital twin. Digital twins allow us to test things that would not be safe or convenient to test in the real world. VP.Start can deal with outages in the digital twin so you don’t have to deal with outages in the real world. VP.Start can practice responding to catastrophic weather events without you having to suffer them in the real world. VP.Start can test very radical, dangerous and expensive theories in the digital twin without any added cost or discomfort to the customers. As this collected Big Data continues to grow exponentially through the endless cycle of Big Data, managing such massive amounts of Big Data in a timely fashion becomes humanly difficult or impossible. This is the point at which VP.Start introduces AI-infusion to the overall Big Data framework. 477 Automation to handle what has become too big for manual management. Cloud Computing means that as handling the data becomes impossible for limited servers and local computer capacity, that volume of Big Data can be handled by computers outside of VP.Start, while still maintaining the strictest cybersecurity. Are you willing to give up control when Big Data becomes too big for human, manual management? How do you make sure that in the automation process, the highest level of cybersecurity is consistently maintained? Ultimately, this Big Data acquisition, simulation and application is integrated directly into AlienCheck meaning that you have access to your data while making sure that others do not have that access. When this system of Big Data, the Big Data cycle, is really functioning fully, the SIMA Big Data Initiative will be lifting and upgrading and empowering all the other missions of the SIMA Journey. The SIMA Journey will expand, extend, deepen and accelerate. But most importantly for most of the readers, you will have access to more reliable and affordable energy, more cost-efficient and less wasteful home appliance and office machinery, more liveable and healthier cities, more productivity and accessibility via the UCN and better lives thanks to the power of SIMA Big Data. SIMA Big Data is the final missing piece in creating a more sustainable world. More savings. Less waste. 478

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Greatest Innovation is an Innovative Voice “Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice
searchIndex.text: More efficiency. Less energy loss. MORE DATA. Are you ready to use data to make better decisions, to test your assumptions and to accelerate your journey? Now is the time to join the data revolution! 479 Chapter 11 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Greatest Innovation is an Innovative Voice “Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice.“ -Steve Jobs In many ways, the most powerful and meaningful innovation that you can have is an innovative voice. In the Ideology section of this book, we talked about developing a powerful voice. Yes, this is indispensable to the growth of VP.Start. But, to be honest, there are people who have powerful voices, but nothing to say. In other words, they have powerful speaking techniques but they do not have an innovative voice. Th at is not acceptable for VP.Start. You can get people’s attention with a powerful voice but you grow with an innovative one . Grow your business. Grow your ideas. Grow you dreams. Grow yourself. For a public speaker to become an world-class communicator, you must develop the ability to speak innovatively. After all, if you tell the world that you have creativity and innovative solutions that can break new ground and change the world but at the same time, 480

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Greatest Innovation is an Innovative Voice “Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice
searchIndex.text: your speaking style is very conventional and traditional , who is going to believe you? Innovators have innovative voices. They speak innovatively. Do you? Be brutally honest with yourself When you say that you are an innovator with innovative ideas, does your voice make them believe you or doubt you? To put it more simply, be yourself . Express yourself, not according to the patterns and precedents of others, according to the standards of conventional speech making or the formulae that others have used before, time and again. This will merely guarantee that your speech will be ordinary and less than compelling. How could it be otherwise? How can you surprise and captivate and amaze people with the ordinary? On the other hand, how can you fail to blow people away when you bring the winds of change to every speech? This means more than just avoiding the traditional practices of mediocre speakers. The much greater challenge is to avoid becoming an imitator of yourself, a clone or digital twin of yourself, if you will. After all, at some point, you will make a great and innovative speech. A speech that captivates the audience and meets all of your goals. You will surprise others and maybe even yourself. But, that success is a danger . At that moment, it is tempting to think that you have created a powerful template for all your speeches going forward. “If it is not broken, don’t f ix it.” Just keep following the same pattern and giving the same speech. 481 But, unfortunately, no one likes to listen to an imitator, even if they are imitating themselves, trying to recapture the glory of his their previous successes. Imitators are boring, to audiences, but especially to the imitators themselves. A true innovator will quickly grow tired of repeating past speeches or reviving past speaking styles, no matter how successful they were in the past. And what happens to the audience when the speaker starts to feel bored and less than enthusiastic? I think we have all seen this movie before. A bored speaker makes for a bored audience. A bored audience makes for an even more bored speaker. This is not the cycle that we want! One of the best ways to judge your effectiveness as a speaker is to ask yourself a question: Do your speeches make you excited or bored? If they make you bored, is that because they are repetitive? If they make you excited, how does the audience react? According to public speaking guru, Bill McGowan, in his book on public speaking, Pitch Perfect , “In public speaking, it is easy to think that since everyone else does something a certain way, this is the only acceptable way of doing things. For example, most people start a speech with an introduction. They thank the audience for coming. They express admiration for the organization that invited them to speak. My belief is the opposite: if you see everyone do something, 482

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Greatest Innovation is an Innovative Voice “Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice
searchIndex.text: you definitely don’t want to do that. It’s time to do the opposite and make yourself distinctive.” Phally could not agree more with this powerful statement. Be distinctive. Be unusual. Be controversial. Be shocking. Be off the wall. Be sensitive. Be risky. Be anything but never, never, never be ordinary. Your “voice” is much more than your sound. Let me give you an example. Phally has long hair, one of his trademarks. Many first time visitors to VP.Start notice this immediately. This is simply not conventional among CEOs in Cambodia. Furthermore, Phally wears clothes at times that are, to put it mildly, unique, because he chooses too. It is not so much that he wants to use his appearance to shock or surprise others. He is authentic and true to himself. He wears what he wants, looks how he wants, says what he wants, and does what he wants. This is his voice, too. In fact, often appearance is the first “voice” that we hear . 483 Is authenticity the safe approach? Certainly not. Does it open Phally up to some heartaches, criticism and mocking? Yes, at times. But the way of a tech CEO and an innovative founder is not the safe way or the easy way or the ordinary way. Phally would never consider choosing any other way than being true to himself. Perhaps, at the end of the day, that is the ultimate difference between a great speaker and a truly innovative world-class communicator , the difference between a powerful voice and an innovative voice that cannot be ignored. Radical, uncompromising authenticity . Does your voice in all its forms (sound, appearance, mannerism, attitude, and the like) serve your innovative ideas and make them more powerful? One frustration that comes with the territory of seeking to be an innovative world-class communicator is the constant feeling of not being as persuasive as needed . Being subpar. Being inadequate, insufficient. The further you push yourself towards perfection , it seems, the more distant that goal seems to become. At times, this can be a heavy weight that CEO Phally tries to bear. He would personally deem that it is almost impossible to give a speech (or sing a song, paint a painting, perform a dance and so on and so on) without feeling that there was at least some part of the speech that could 484

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Greatest Innovation is an Innovative Voice “Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice
searchIndex.text: have been better. The more seriously you take the results and the more deeply you feel the burden of your mission and your vision, the more likely you are to be devastated by the slightest imperfection. Phally has had to work hard to train himself to be data-driven and results-driven as opposed to emotion-driven. A world-class communicator doesn’t go solely on how he or she feels about her speech. To do so, would be a recipe for endless torture and frustration. Are you seeking innovative perfection without becoming a perfectionist? We need to ask ourselves, what were the goals of this speech? What did we want the audience to do after the speech? What did we want them to feel, believe and remember and take home with them? And how well did we reach these goals? This moves the results from the realm of emotional speculation to that of data-driven results . To be brutally honest, this is still a work in progress for Phally and he still occasionally gets disturbed or discouraged by his own dissatisfaction with his speaking abilities. But increasingly, he is moving in the direction of looking at the results. Every true world-class communicator must move in that direction or risk getting blown off course completely by every negative thought that happens to pop into their creative heads. Phally has found that one of the best ways to determine the success or failure of a speech is 485 to allow questions after the speech. Are there many questions? Are they surface questions or penetrating questions? Are they perfunctory questions or are they asked with ardor and passion, with a genuine desire to know and to grow? A great speech, especially a great tech speech, should not only answer a number of questions but it should raise even more. If people walk away from a speech feeling that they completely understand the subject, how could that have been an innovative speech? On the other hand completely, if the audience walks away consumed by burning questions and a powerful itch to know more, the results have borne out clearly that this speech achieved the goals intended. When you raise your innovative voice, does it lead to questions? Do people want to know more about your ideas and solutions? If they don’t, why do you think they are not motivated to ask questions? Phally often says that he doesn’t want to reach the level of a native speaker of English because there are many native speakers of English who are very underwhelming speakers. He has a loftier goal, one that is harder to express, but that is absolutely real. He wants to reach the level of the greatest innovative communicators , 486

searchIndex.title: Chapter 11 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Greatest Innovation is an Innovative Voice “Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice
searchIndex.text: whether in English or Khmer. Actually, language is not that important at that point. He sees the final stage of this process as the ability to speak impromptu . In other words, if you give people a topic and time to prepare, most people can come up with a reasonably well-crafted speech . Give them time to research the topic and discuss communication strategies with advisors and consultants and even a mediocre speaker will come up with something that while not compelling or mesmerizing, is at least adequate. But what if they are given an unexpected topic, suddenly, without any preparation or time to consult with others? Better still, or harder still, what if this is a topic that in outside of their area of expertise, outside of their comfort zone ? What if they are required to begin speaking on the spot , off the cuff, off the top of their heads and give an answer that will satisfy both the experts and non-experts who may be residing in the audience? Does it seem borderline impossible? A monumental, herculean challenge? Once again, “If it is not impossible, it is not worth doing.” This is the goal towards which Phally is always striving. Innovative, impromptu speaking. When you speak without preparation, you have no choice but to be yourself. You have no time to become anyone else. 487 You can only share what it already inside of you . Phally would not say that he has already achieved this status or that he will ever fully achieve it. This ability remains somewhat beyond the grasp of even the most excellent orators to ever walk our planet. It is perhaps the loftiest goal. Certainly, you might say that this may amount to trying to “reach the unreachable star” but I am willing to suggest that most of the greatest accomplishments that have been achieved in history and in speaking, were achieved by those who dared to raise their voice and tried to do the impossible , those who felt the bitter sting of self-dissatisfaction, those who could never quite reach the impossible standard that they set for themselves and yet, raised their voice and kept on raising it and refused to be silent until the world was theirs! When you are given an unplanned opportunity to share your ideas and innovations, Are you always ready and excited to share what you have inside? Do you embrace the opportunity and make your case powerfully? Phally would surely tell each and every one of you that you have a powerful and compelling voice. You have your own unique content that you need to share with the world with all the passion that you feel for this vision. You can become a powerful speaker in your language or in whatever other languages you may choose to employ. You can become an empathetic and powerful active listener 488

searchIndex.title: Chapter 12 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Future of the SIMA Journey “Th e future is an unknown, but a somewhat predictable unknown
searchIndex.text: who understands the needs, wishes, hopes and fears of your listeners. You can boldly dive outside your comfort zone, take on the most unexpected and challenging questions and topics with panache, speak creatively and disruptively and reach or surpass whatever standard you set for yourself. Why? Because you are you, you are unique, you are your authentic self. Nothing more is required. So, where is your voice? Th e world is waiting. We need to hear from you. Be bold, be yourself, be brave, be indomitable, be authentic. Be world-class! 489 Chapter 12 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Future of the SIMA Journey “Th e future is an unknown, but a somewhat predictable unknown. To look to the future, we must fi rst look back upon the past. Th at is where the seeds of the future were planted.” -Albert Einstein Congratulations, dear readers! You have made it to the end of our book. But this not the end of our journey . A book must eventually finish. A journey does not. Th e SIMA Journey never ends. You and I will end our journey someday but the next generation will keep the journey going forward. As Professor Albert said, the future is unknown, but not completely unknown . Th e SIMA Journey gives us a framework to have some certainty about the future even though we don’t have any absolute promises or guarantees. As by now you surely know, the SIMA Journey starts with our S tory . But let’s be very clear about something. S tory is not the same thing as History. History is what has already happened in the past. Th ings that cannot be changed. 490

searchIndex.title: Chapter 12 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Future of the SIMA Journey “Th e future is an unknown, but a somewhat predictable unknown
searchIndex.text: Things that cannot be upgraded or updated because they are already past. S tory includes the past but also the present and the future . We use the data of the past and the experiences of the present to extrapolate about the future . If our S tory was only about the past, there would be little point in revisiting it. After all, as the song says, “The good old days weren’t always good and tomorrow isn’t as bad as it seems.” In this regard, our S tory is very similar to data science in all its three main components. The past part of our Story is similar to data acquisition . We gather data from the past and use it to predict the future. The present part of our Story are the simulations where we try out various ideas, theories, strategies and approaches, some successful and some definitely not. The future part of our Story is similar to data application , where we take the lessons, the “seeds” of the past and “plant” them in the real world. Of course, the future quickly becomes the past and we restart the process over and over again. What lessons are you deriving from your past experiences and current simulations? How are you integrating these actionable insights into your innovative operations? For VP.Start, the past includes both successes and failures . Of course! 491 New contracts and new markets. Failed attempts to gain investment. Amazing conferences. Missed opportunities. Powerful stakeholders and supporters. Ungrateful team members who steal our ideas and try to destroy the our creations. New innovations. Implementation delays. New OEM partners. Challenges in intellectual property transfers and Maintaining high standards of quality. Expanded funding support and grants from international organizations. Obstacles to compliance with regulatory frameworks. Burgeoning recognition and new connections across the ASEAN region. Slower growth than we would hope for at times. Based on these past results, we are constantly making changes and trying out new, outside the box strategies. New ways of marketing. More innovative speaking and pitching. More effective storytelling. 492

searchIndex.title: Chapter 12 SIMA Amazing Innovation: The Future of the SIMA Journey “Th e future is an unknown, but a somewhat predictable unknown
searchIndex.text: New ways to access international markets. Will these plans ALL succeed? I can safely answer…. NO! As time goes by and as these plans of the future turn into the successes or failures of the past , we are gathering more actionable intelligence to keep the SIMA Journey going forward. Are you gaining actionable intelligence from your successes without becoming overconfident ? Are you gaining actionable intelligence from your failures without becoming discouraged ? The next step in the VP.Start future is our SIMA Ideology. Ideology is the next step in your future as well. Ideology moves our journey from the raw data of the past to data analysis . The S tory tells us what happened. The Ideology is how we interpret those events and what lessons we draw from them. Please remember this. Data is valuable or worthless depending on the quality of analysis. Sadly, many companies are accumulating data in the same way that they collect garbage . Data is gathered and stored but that data is never analyzed or, at best, is analyzed improperly. That data is wasting space, energy, 493 effort and money. Not exactly very sustainable. We, on the other hand, use our Ideology to move into the future. The SIMA Ideology rests on Innovation through Technology . So, what new ideas will come to VP.Start in the future as we create, build, refine and visualize the sustainability system? That is hard to determine at this point. But one thing is absolutely certain. Ideas will come first . Innovative ideas will come first . And then, our amazing team will create the technology that turns these ideas into reality. Innovation through Technology. As we move into new markets like India and the Philippines and Indonesia and others, we will face new obstacles or old obstacles in new formats. Creative technology will be required to navigate past these challenges. We will keep our eyes on the Big Picture. Overarching sustainability for the world. We will not allow VP.Start to be derailed from the track. We will not excessively focus on details and components instead of the overall vision. We refuse to become a manufacturing company or an engineering factory. We will insist on being idea-driven and data-driven. It is reasonable to assume that in the future there will be increasing temptations and pressures to move away from the Big Picture vision. 494

searchIndex.text: Pressures to move into trendy sectors like EV adoption, renewable integration, AI Data Centers implementation and the like. But our idea-driven , not product-driven approach, our data-driven , not profit-driven philosophy will protect us from getting off the track. How are you adapting your ideology to changing circumstances while simultaneously protecting your core values and vision? In the future, we will continue to rely on our three-pronged approach to powerful thinking : namely, logical thinking, creative thinking and positive thinking in order to keep moving forward. One issue for us as we face the future unafraid is to make sure that all team members are acting creatively and positively, not just logically. To be honest, this can be challenging at times. Especially since we recognize that the CEO will not be with us forever, we must all learn to stand in our own creativity and positivity. Otherwise, we risk becoming a conventional, ordinary company with products to sell instead of ideas to tell. 495 Are you employing threefold powerful thinking? Are you logical? Are you creative? Are you positive? What areas of powerful thinking are your strengths? Which areas do you need to improve? How are you proactively reducing the risk of you losing your innovative edge? We are already moving actively towards decentralization , especially in terms of our voice. We intend to get more people involved with pitching, planning, decision making, training, speaking, publicizing. In the Friday weekly, SIMA Journey Workshop, this is already taking place as more and more team members are getting chances to raise their voices. As we decentralization expands and accelerates , traditional departments and hierarchies will become less important, perhaps even obsolete. as indeed they have already started to become. Do your innovations promote decentralization? Or can they only succeed with your direct and active involvement? If your innovations depend excessively on you and on your top-down leadership, they will leave the scene as soon as you do At the end of the day, VP.Start’s ultimate success or failure in the future will depend on our ability to develop a world-class corporate voice 496

searchIndex.text: today and on our ability to learn to be ourselves now . The same is true for all of you. So, where will our voice and our authenticity take us? That will depend deeply on our Methodology . If Ideology is similar to data analysis, Methodology moves us forward into data model building and data model evaluation. Feeding the data into the system, checking the results, increasing the accuracy, redoing the process. SIMA Methodology has been a continuous process of adaptation and growth . It will be in the future as well. For VP.Start. For you, too. Let me give a very concrete example. We started our grid modernization and SIMA Smart Grid solutions with the DRC-001 , a solution specifically designed for a very detailed problem . The DRC-001 was tasked with modernizing existing infrastructure of the grid, particularly focused on the Auto Circuit Reclosers associated with ADVC Cabinets produced by Schneider Electric . This was a big step forward in SIMA Smart Grid implementation. The DRC-001 is an excellent solution for a very specific aspect of grid architecture but we soon found that there were other problems that needed our attention also. For example, we needed DRC capabilities to monitor and manage 497 Load Break Switches (LBS) and we needed to eliminate costly and wasteful manual inspection trips for these LBSs. So… the DRC-002 was born . Not all ADVC Cabinets are produced by Schneider. We needed a new solution for those produced by Cooper Electronics… So we created the DRC-003 . Do you see the pattern? With each new step forward, new problems and new needs appeared . A new variation, a new iteration of the DRC technology was required. We have kept on adapting and upgrading and revising the DRC into new versions to meet new challenges. Currently there are 12 distinct DRC hardware options. Some designed to interface with various manufacturers or various pieces of grid infrastructure. Some designed purely for data gathering purposes. Still others designed specifically for energy metering, including remote measurement, billing and consumption auditing. New challenges keep leading us to create new solutions . New solutions that create new, additional, unexpected challenges . The cycle continues. That is the core essence of the SIMA Methodology. Moving forward, these various remote control features are being combined into one overarching DRC universal controller . This, too, is a key aspect of VP.Start methodology. Creating new and varied innovative solutions. 498

searchIndex.text: Yes. Combining these different ideas into one overarching framework. Yes. Th e future belongs not so much to those who have infi nite, random, innovative ideas but to those who can bring those ideas together into one synergistic architecture . Also, in the near future, the SIMA Methodology will move the DRC from hardware to software . YES. Instant remote installation anywhere in the world. So while we may not exactly know the parameters and details of the future, we have a flexible and agile methodology ready to move in whatever direction necessary. Solving new problems as they arise. Creating an overarching framework to integrate those solutions into a Big Picture vision. Moving those solutions from tangible products to digitized software solutions. Do your innovations solve new problems as they arise? Are you creating an overarching framework to combine all your ideas into one Big Picture? Are you moving away from physical, tangible solutions to digital, remotely accessible ones? Th e way of innovation is endless. After all, that is the meaning of innovation. IN+NOV+ATION “IN” means something “within” an existing object or practice 499 “NOV” means “make new”, “renew” or “alter” “ATION” means “a process” or “an action” So “INNOVATION” means the process or the action of making something new or altering an existing practice. Making something new is continual and unstoppable. We at VP.Start are constantly innovating. But that doesn’t mean chaos. We are constantly altering the SIMA Methodology and improving the SIMA Ideology to create even better SIMA Amazing Innovations that always fi t with the original SIMA Journey that started when our CEO was born. Old. New. Always changing. Always headed to an unchanging goal. We are arrogant enough . We are arrogant enough to change. We are arrogant enough to change the world. We are arrogant enough to change the world into a more sustainable one. We are arrogant enough to change the world into a more sustainable one TODAY. So the final question is simple: How arrogant are you? 500

searchIndex.title: About the Writer Geoff Dean
searchIndex.text: ABOUT THE WRITER Geoff Dean Writer of The SIMA Journey “Every meaningful journey begins with an idea—and every great idea begins with the courage to dare to be yourself.” Geoff Dean is the writer of Th e SIMA Journey, a book dedicated to the innovative, idea-driven vision, and forward-thinking spirit of VP.Start. 507 Th rough his engagement with VP.Start’s journey, he adopted the belief that innovation is not simply about creating new technology, but about transforming ideas into sustainable solutions for our people, our region and our planet. Geoff explores a journey where creativity, logic, sustainability, and positivity come together. The story invites readers to look beyond what technology is today—to envision what we can create when ideas are unlocked, unleashed, and unimpeded. Th e SIMA Journey is therefore not just a story about VP.Start’s technology, but the story of the innovator that you were born to be and the amazing innovations that you were born to create. Our SIMA journeys continue with every idea we dare to imagine, every innovation we dare to create, and every time we dare to unlock ourselves. 508
